criteria.notes: white sparkling, Prosecco (Glera, Italy), for a birthday toast; no food stated

searches.query: putojantis vynas prosecco doc extra dry 0,75 l

shortlist.name: Putojantis vynas SAN MARTINO CONEGLIANO VALDOBBIADENE PROSECCO SUPERIORE DOCG, 0,75 l
shortlist.reason: The only Prosecco Superiore DOCG found within budget, so the most special bottle for a birthday; 11%, Italy. Sweetness is not stated, the bottle deposit is extra, and IKI says the shelf price prevails if it differs.

shortlist.name: Putojantis vynas MIONETTO PROSECCO DOC TREVISO BRUT, 0,75 l
shortlist.reason: Cheapest of the five and a widely known label; dry Brut that suits a toast, and the price leaves room for a second bottle. Per-litre price of 11,99 €/l confirms 8.99.

shortlist.name: Mionetto Prosecco Extra Dry 0,75 L
shortlist.reason: Extra Dry style, a touch softer than Brut and easy for a mixed group of guests; Glera, Veneto, 11%. The page's own category field says very dry/brut nature, which contradicts the name.

shortlist.name: Maschio Prosecco Treviso Extra Dry 0,75 l
shortlist.reason: Prosecco Treviso Extra Dry at a euro less than the Mionetto in the same shop; white, 11%, natural cork.

shortlist.name: Putojantis vynas I Heart Prosecco D.O.C. 0,75 l
shortlist.reason: Dry Prosecco DOC, 100% Glera, 10.5%, with a playful label that suits a party; ranked last because delivery takes 1-3 working days.

notes: All five product pages read fitted the brief, so nothing was rejected; 3 of 8 page reads were left unused because the searches surfaced no further product pages on the five shops (vynokambarys.lt appeared only as a category page). The vynomeka price appears as '995 €' with the decimal separator lost; read as 9.95 because the same page prints its 80.00 € free-delivery threshold as '8000 €'. No page states stock explicitly, so inStock is null throughout. Producer is null where the page names only a supplier or nothing; Rimi lists Mionetto as the brand. 'Under €12' was taken as a ceiling of 12.
